lines.text: Jesus and His disciples leave Jericho with a large crowd, and blind Bartimaeus sits beside the road.
Bartimaeus cries out to Jesus, Son of David, for mercy, and when many tell him to be silent, he shouts louder.
Jesus keeps walking and sends a disciple to bless him, so the crowd tells Bartimaeus to stay put.

wrong_details.wrong: Jesus keeps walking and sends a disciple to bless him
the crowd tells Bartimaeus to stay put
wrong_details.true: they told him to take courage and get up

lines.text: Bartimaeus throws off his cloak, comes to Jesus, and asks Him to let him walk again.
Jesus says his faith has healed him, and Bartimaeus immediately receives his sight and follows Jesus along the road.
